ruled_out.anchor_regression_packaging: a packaging account of the 30% attenuation requires a negative packaging main effect; P_multi is entirely positive, so only packaging-under-self-attribution survives, which IS attribution-gating
ruled_out.item_selection: crossed on the same 3 items, selection is a common constant that cannot flip the ratio structure; A_self reproduces to 3dp for the third time (selection-on-noise predicts shrinkage)
ruled_out.negation_processing: shallow negation predicts P_multi ~ A_self (-0.872); measured +0.077 CI [+0.050,+0.105], and it sits on the independently replicating other-arm anchor (+0.060)
ruled_out.second_person_testimony: the full-size effect appears in an arm with NO testimony (A_self, structural role tokens only); the assertion-bearing OTHERM arm goes the other way -- the TARGET of attribution carries the sign, not the act of assertion
ruled_out.single_run: anchors reproduce prior stages exactly; run-level variance <0.001 vs the 0.686 gap between A_quoted and P_multi with disjoint CIs

values.harness: latent_skeptic triage_workflow.js (Opus), 11 skeptics + 2 isolated readers; both claims re-derived from raw rows including independent key application and prompt-text verification: reproduce to 3dp.
